tools.name: ide_list
tools.description: List VB6 IDE instances discovered on this machine (port scan 8766..8799 plus VB6MCP_PORT and HKCU\Software\VB6MCP\Port). Reports faceSource (live|snapshot), the snapshot contractVersion/toolCount, each instance's pid/project/port, and any conflict (two instances on one project). Read-only.

tools.name: ide_target
tools.description: Set or clear the default IDE target used when a tools/call has no _target. target = pid | project name | "auto". Hub-local state only.

tools.name: ide_start
tools.description: Start a VB6 IDE for the given project (.vbp). Minimal mode: needs VB6MCP_AUTOSTART_PROJECT or an explicit project plus a resolvable VB6.EXE; otherwise returns a structured not_implemented with the reason.

tools.name: ide_stop
tools.description: Stop an IDE instance. It only stops instances started by this hub; otherwise returns a structured not_allowed with the reason.

tools.name: ide_restart
tools.description: RECOVER a wedged IDE by stopping OUR OWN instance and starting it again on the same project. Sequence: best-effort save_project -> graceful quit_ide -> confirm the process is gone (force kill only if it will not go) -> clear our own instances/<pid>.json registry entry -> start VB6.EXE on the same .vbp -> wait for the new instance -> prove three-way readiness (add-in answers, mcp_info answers, project matches). It NEVER stops an instance below port 8767: 8766 belongs to an EXTERNAL process on this machine (discipline 107). Every path returns the same key set: {ok,restarted,stoppedPid,newPid,port,project,targetSource,ownership,refused_reason,stopConfirmed,saveAttempted,saveOk,registryCleared,lockCleared,three_way_ok,threeWay,vb6Exe,vb6ExeSource,waitMs,instances,steps,note}.

pid.description: The instance to restart (as reported by ide_list). Omit when exactly ONE instance is online.

project.description: The .vbp to restart the IDE on. Required unless the target instance reports its project path.

tools.name: list_lessons
tools.description: List the VB6MCP lessons (experience library): scenario / trap / do with scope and enabled state.

tools.name: add_lesson
tools.description: Add or overwrite a lesson in the user layer (mcp_lessons/user.json) with a .bak backup.

tools.name: delete_lesson
tools.description: Remove a user lesson, or disable a shipped one (writes enabled=false).

tools.name: export_lessons
tools.description: Export the merged lesson library as Markdown (re-importable via import_lessons_md).

tools.name: import_lessons_md
tools.description: Import lessons from a Markdown file: a line '## [id] scenario' plus trap:/do: lines.

dryRun.description: Parse only, do not write (default false)
